purpose: Complete collected records; file metadata controls indexing eligibility.

meta.title: USC finance and health portals for new students
meta.summary: Directory of the USC portals a new student uses to pay tuition and complete health requirements.

records.name: USCe.pay (Pay My Bill)
records.purpose: View the student account balance and eBills, pay tuition and fees, set up payment plans, invite payers and sign up for direct deposit refunds.
common_tasks: send a payer invitation to a parent
sign up for direct deposit refunds
records.access_path: Experience USC > Student Resources > Finances & Billing > Pay My Bill

records.name: USCe.pay guest (payer) login
records.purpose: Lets a parent or sponsor invited by the student view the account and pay on the student's behalf.

records.name: Flywire International Payment Plan
records.purpose: Monthly tuition installment plan paid from a non-U.S. bank account in the student's local currency.
common_tasks: enroll in an international payment plan
records.access_path: Experience USC > Student Resources > Finances & Billing > Flywire International Payment Plan

records.name: MySHR (USC Student Health portal)
records.purpose: Student Health patient portal for health clearances, immunization uploads, appointments, secure messages, the insurance waiver and Student Health charges.
records.access_path: Experience USC > Student Resources > Health & Emergencies > MySHR

records.name: Aetna Student Health (USC SHIP)
records.purpose: Insurer portal for USC SHIP members to get the insurance ID card, find in-network providers and view claims.

records.name: Experience USC
records.purpose: USC student portal that links to all student services, including Pay My Bill, MySHR, Web Registration and profile settings such as SSN/ITIN.
common_tasks: add SSN or ITIN to profile

records.name: USCard eAccounts (USCard Services portal)
records.purpose: Manage the USCard student ID: add discretionary funds, view balances and transactions, view meal plan (board) transactions, freeze or reactivate a lost card and set alerts.
records.access_path: mycard.usc.edu > Log In to Your USCard Account > Students

records.name: IERF credential evaluation (USC degree certification)
records.purpose: External service where admits with foreign degrees apply for the IERF General Certification of Studies for USC to satisfy the degree verification registration requirement.
common_tasks: apply for General Certification of Studies for USC
send report to USC Degree Progress
